name: Over/under book
summary: A friend sportsbook: 1 to 3 props with over/under lines or yes/no calls, 100 pt picks, lines that move as people bet, and payouts once someone calls the result.
useWhen: betting on friends for fun before a night out: 'over under on Lily being late'
calls before a show or game: 'which song opens', 'what time does she go on', 'how many songs before the encore'
dontUseWhen: a plain vote on what to do (use a poll)
guessing one exact answer with a winner (use a guessing game)

params.title: card title
params.props: 1-3 x {who, title, context, kind: 'line'|'call', line, short, lean 120-880, trend: number[] up to 11}
params.book: earlier bets for the ticker: {who, prop, side 0|1, pts}[]
